Doordarshan Celebrates 67th Foundation Day Across India

Public broadcaster Doordarshan marked its 67th Foundation Day on September 23. Celebrations were held across various Doordarshan Kendras (DDKs), including Srinagar. The event also coincided with National Engineers' Day in Srinagar. Doordarshan, established in 1959, is India's public service broadcaster.
